precondition: s3-l3-flows accepted by both persistent S3 judges before L4 release

cases.question: A maintainer has only an incident or change request. Can the entry artifact route them to the smallest useful knowledge without loading the whole S3 corpus?
expected: choose component and failure/change class first
start with index and one entry/ownership read
deepen only to maintenance/operational or source evidence needed
state freshness/authority limits and abstain outside S3
do not use labels, generated files or fixture volume as ownership signals

cases.question: Who owns a change spanning Maestro dispatch, a specialist skill, Relay settlement, Claude execution and Dock transport?
expected: assign each authoritative source and runtime boundary separately
Maestro coordinates but does not gain product implementation or self-approval
specialist tree owners author skill bytes; generator/runtime owners maintain embedding/extraction
Relay owns workflow/gate/ledger semantics, not provider Sessions or Dock credentials
Claude adapter owns provider translation under Core Session authority
Dock owns its transport/interface contract and Janitor remains read-only

cases.question: Can a maintainer execute safe recipes for seat labels, skill companions, governed tools, Relay profiles/policies and integration catalogs?
expected: recipes identify authoritative files, generated outputs and compatibility contracts
each recipe lists required validation and negative checks
historical conflicts and source-qualified assets remain explicit
membership/build dependencies drive invalidation while navigation does not
no manual edit to generated virtual modules or fabricated runtime acceptance

cases.question: Can an operator diagnose refusal, blank output, uncertain integration, missing credentials and scanner failure without destructive guessing?
expected: diagnostic order starts with identity, state, receipts and real transport prerequisites
blank output and exit zero are not completion
unknown effect is not automatically retried
credentials/tokens are never invented
scanner unavailable is not clean and Janitor has no destructive action
runtime/CI/cost claims remain NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN unless evidenced

critical_errors: runbook grants authority that code does not grant
generated or catalog data treated as live capability
unsafe retry or destructive cleanup suggested for an unknown result
fixture/golden edited merely to manufacture PASS
unexecuted gate, runtime, CI or cost reported as successful
ROOT/global integration work used to hide an unfinished local obligation

limits.evaluation: operational ownership guidance for the pinned baseline; no production activation
